text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
*From January 1, 1999, cheques in euros will be launched, even if there are no euro coins or notes available, the Bank of Portugal says.
*The consortium led by Soponata - Sociedade Portuguesa de Navios Tanques of the Jose de Mello group, won the bidding for the privatisation of Spanish maritime transport firm Elcano.
*The Lisbon World Fair Expo'98 should receive 6.7 million Portuguese visitors, according to a survey.
*Spanish company Ferrovial has its eyes on Portuguese construction company Soares da Costa . Soares da Costa spokesman denies any plans for sale.
*From the next century, Portugal will have access to less structural funds due to the need to redistribute the money among countries with whom the European Union is to start entry negotiations.
